purpose: Execute unchanged generated plane contact equations on CPU; not a mesh or DEM benchmark
reference: Independent FP64 nodal_force with doubled half-weight coefficients for full-weight wall variant; independent energy, torque and dissipation algebra
coordinate_units: metres; SI force N, torque Nm, energy J
geometry: Synthetic fixed plane +z, offset 0; no external meshes, no geometry processing
limits: No geometry queries, neighbour search, history lookup, force reduction, state integration, GPU comparison or whole-case throughput
